title: 836. Push Dominoes

examples.explanation: The middle dot is pulled both ways and stays upright.

hints: Compute a left-to-right force wave (R pushes decay with distance, L resets it) and a mirrored right-to-left wave, then combine them.
A positive combined force means R wins, a negative one means L wins, and zero means the piece stays upright.
Segments between an R and a later L split in the middle; equal halves leave the centre standing when the gap is odd.
